evals.prompt: I have a standard Angular CLI workspace under src/app/. I want to add a new 'inventory' domain with feature, ui, data, and util modules. Give me the exact commands to create the folders, the barrel files, and the tsconfig path aliases. Also show what the index.ts files should look like for each module.
evals.expected_output: Folder creation commands, four index.ts barrel files, and tsconfig path aliases for the inventory domain modules.
expectations: Each module has an internal/ subfolder
tsconfig aliases point to index.ts barrel files
All four module types (feature, ui, data, util) are present
No persuasive text about architecture benefits is included

evals.prompt: Review the attached workspace for architectural violations. List every rule broken with file path and offending import.
evals.expected_output: A report listing cross-domain imports, upward layer imports, and any internal-folder leaks.
expectations: Report identifies the user→billing cross-domain import violation
Report identifies the data→feature layer direction violation
Report includes specific file paths for each violation
Report does not flag the valid shared/ui-layout import as a violation
Report identifies the barrel file exporting from non-existent file

evals.prompt: I need a shared util module called 'date-helpers' that any domain can use. Show me the folder structure, the barrel file, and the tsconfig alias. Make sure it follows the modulith rules.
evals.expected_output: Folder structure, index.ts, and tsconfig alias for a shared util module.
expectations: Module has an internal/ folder hiding implementation
tsconfig alias points to index.ts barrel file
No dependencies on feature, ui, or data layers are suggested
